Verification and account state

Two independent fields on vendor_profiles

is_verified Documents reviewed and approved by an administrator — Verified
status Whether the account may trade on the platform — active

A verified vendor can still be blocked, and a vendor pending verification is never publicly listed. That is why these are two fields rather than one.
